Searching for a Greek green card on Telegram returns a hundred near-identical adverts and no way to rank them. The only reliable filter is knowing what the Decentralised Administration puts on the document and what a print cannot reproduce.

A green card is the United States permanent resident card. Outside the United States the same job is done by a permanent residence card, and sellers use the American term loosely for every country.

buy greek green card on telegram – the short version

The price question and the quality question are the same question for a Greek green card. Cheap means the security layer was skipped, and the security layer is the only part that is hard to fake.

The next section covers how the transaction itself runs, because the ordering of photos, checks and payment is where most deals actually fail, not the document inspection.

Buy a Green Card via Telegram: how the transaction works

Treat the chat as a written record. Ask in full sentences, keep the answers, screenshot the price. If the deal sours you will want the thread rather than a summary of it.

If the deal collapses after the deposit, write a dated summary in the chat, name the amount and stop. Sellers respond to a record far more than to complaint.

Who actually issues a Green Card

The issuing authority for a Greek green card is the Decentralised Administration. Nobody on Telegram issues anything. Sellers are downstream of that office and the only question worth asking is how many steps downstream they are.

Local name matters more than it sounds. Using adeia diamonis rather than a translated term shows the seller you are not reading from a generic script, and the quality of the answers changes immediately.

Replica or registered original

Replica and registered original are used interchangeably in adverts and they are not the same purchase. A replica is a print. It copies the layout and fails on UV, on substrate and on the number.

The failure modes are different too. A print fails the first UV torch. Stock fails the number. A registered original fails only if the entry has lapsed or the details do not match it.

What a fair price looks like

Fair pricing on a Greek green card is not about the cheapest number in the chat. It is about paying the bottom of the band for a print and the top only when somebody shows a register hit.

If a quote is far below, ask what was left out. The answer is almost always the security layer or the stock, and either one turns the document into a print.

The buying process, step by step

Follow these in sequence and stop at the first one that fails.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the Decentralised Administration.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the Decentralised Administration uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 290–950 EUR band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

These are the checks that separate a real Greek green card from a good print. All of them are cheap to run and two are local to Greece.

  • Check the licence for the Greek and Latin transliteration of the name and the EU category grid.
  • Confirm the passport key pattern and the machine-readable zone transliteration.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the Decentralised Administration. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

If you see any of these, stop paying attention to the price.

  • A document where the Latin transliteration does not match the Greek spelling.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What does a green card cost on Telegram?

Between 350 and 1600 US dollars. The top of the band is where a number that resolves at the immigration office should sit.

Is a green card the same as a residence permit?

In the United States yes, in practice. Elsewhere the green card is the permanent tier and the residence permit is the fixed term tier below it.

Can the number be checked?

Only against the immigration register. Ask the seller which register the number sits in and expect a specific answer.

Why are green cards so expensive?

Because the number carries the most weight of any document here and the register check is the hardest to fake.

What is the usual fake?

A high quality print of a real card with the number left intact and the personal details changed.

Before you pay
